name: Round Table

attributes.attribute: has a name close to Galahaut

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Round Table is a term for the fellowship of knights who served King Arthur. The extract records that Lancelot had a single sibling, Galehodin, whose life is otherwise unrecord. He is ringed by figures with names like his, including Galahad and Galahaut, whose nearness hints at a shared source. This similarity suggests a common origin.

okr.objective: Present the Round Table as the Arthurian fellowship centered around Lancelot.
key_results: Lancelot had one obscure brother, Galehodin.
Figures close to Lancelot carry like names.
Galahad and Galahaut may share one origin.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
